Kumel Ahmed (CT-22034)

Project Details: This project develops a voice agent that calls patients after they use an ambulance service, speaks to them in Urdu or English, and gathers feedback on the care they received. The system converts speech to text, understands spoken responses, and summarises the results for service quality managers.

Title: MemTrace: Lifecycle-Aware Provenance for Detecting and Mitigating Memory Poisoning Attacks in LLM Agents
Team Members:
Rameen (CT-23004)
Tooba Rehman (CT-23011)
Fatima (CT-23012)
Huda Imran (CT-23015)
Project Details: MemTrace is a security framework that protects LLM agents’ persistent memory from poisoning, where false or malicious information gets stored and later influences the agent across sessions. Instead of checking memory at only one stage, it tracks each entry’s origin, trust level and history through six lifecycle stages (write, store, retrieve, use, propagate, forget/rollback) and uses that provenance to flag, isolate, delete or roll back suspicious memories.

Title: Naqshkaar: A Multimodal AI System for Constraint-Aware 3D Interior Design Generation
Team Members:
Mureed Hussain (Team Lead - CT-23036)
Muhammad Sami (CT-23027)
Faiq Ahmed (CT-23030)
Muhammad Sameed (CT-23046)
Project Details: Naqshkaar is an AI interior design platform for Pakistan that generates 3D room designs from a real catalogue of purchasable local products, scaled to true room dimensions and checked against space and budget limits. Unlike tools such as Planner 5D or RoomGPT, it uses PKR prices, accounts for local needs like ceiling-fan clearance, AC and UPS placement, and prayer space, and lets users pick each item from AI-shortlisted options. The result is a design they can visualize and buy, with an itemised cost estimate and direct purchase links.
